source='''def transform(grid):\n    out = [row[:] for row in grid]\n    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))\n    for r, row in enumerate(grid):\n        if row and row[0] != bg and row[-1] == bg:\n            c = row[0]\n            k = 0\n            while k < len(row) and row[k] == c:\n                k += 1\n            if k < len(row) and all(x == bg for x in row[k:]):\n                out[r][k:] = [1] * (len(row) - k)\n    return out\n'''
